articleTitle: Recent art and science of copper vapour lasers
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Gas Lasers - Art and Applications
abstract: The authors describe the requirements necessary to establish gain in the discharge tube of a copper vapour laser, and the practical means of achieving these.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Gas Lasers - Art and Applications
abstract: The author presents a brief review of the activity in the Excimer laser section of the 'Eurolaser' programme. Eurolaser forms a part of the broader 'Eureka' initiative-a joint European venture with the aim of developing advanced technologies for industrial and commercial use. The context of the Excimer programme in relation to the parallel efforts on CO/sub 2/, CO and YAG laser technology will be set out.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

articleTitle: Gas lasers for coherent and incoherent optical sensors
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Gas Lasers - Art and Applications
abstract: The author describes the use of gas lasers as the optical source available for optical sensors, and discusses the advantages of the use of the lasers in coherent sensing applications.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Gas Lasers - Art and Applications
abstract: The role of the excimer laser in medicine is discussed. In addition to describing the use of the excimer laser in two specific areas, namely ophthalmology and microsurgery, the issues of laser performance requirements are addressed and the area is put in context in terms of market size and segmentation.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

articleTitle: 17 GHz excitation of argon ion and helium-krypton ion lasers
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Gas Lasers - Art and Applications
abstract: A magnetron operating at 17 GHz delivers 40 kW pulses into a microwave coupling structure producing a transverse electric field of approximately 10/sup 6/ V/m. Laser action has been observed in a variety of Argon, Helium-Argon and Helium-Krypton gas mixtures. The microwave power absorption efficiency as a function of excitation frequency is considered. Time-resolved spectroscopy is used to monitor the variation of output against gas mixture ratio and pressure, and input power characteristics.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

articleTitle: Analysis of laser diode based synthetic wave heterodyne interferometry
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Gas Lasers - Art and Applications
abstract: The author presents an analysis of the coherent mixing of a base laser set in adjacent line pairs in order to generate a set of synthetic wavelengths whose phase relationship is measured and used to determine a required range. The analysis is required to compute the target range of space born multiple-array radio and optical frequency interferometers.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>
